**Best move:** Rd2+

**Main line:** Rd2+ Kh3 (or Qxd2 Bxd2) Rxc2 winning the queen.

**Motif:** fork

**Explanation (80 words):**

Your rook on d7 delivers check on d2 while forking the queen and bishop—White cannot defend both. After Kh3 (or any king move), you capture the undefended queen with Rxc2, winning decisive material. After Qxd2, your bishop simply takes Bxd2. The key lesson: when your rook has a clear line to the back rank, check if it can attack the queen or another piece simultaneously. Look for forks involving checks and distant pieces on the same rank or file.
